title: AgenticSystemCore bundle root
description: Frontmatter of content/index.md, the Bundle root document (AGSC-01-04). It MUST NOT carry a type key: the root is not an item and does not enter the graph as one. additionalProperties is true: unknown keys are preserved and reported as AGSC-E207 warnings (AGSC-02-05). CC0-1.0.

spec_version.description: SemVer; a reader MUST accept any Bundle whose MAJOR equals its own (AGSC-00-14, AGSC-00-17).

okf_version.description: Open Knowledge Format version this Bundle is a superset of; allowed at the bundle root only.

base.description: Absolute https origin, trailing slash optional; the IRI base of every item (AGSC-01-19, AGSC-05-01). MUST equal site.base in agsc.config.json, including the http://localhost[:port]/ development placeholder written by adoption (D52(1)).

license.description: SPDX or LicenseRef identifier covering the prose of this Bundle (AGSC-06-15).

operator.description: AGSC-02-07 as amended by D48(5): human:<id> only.
